name: v1.22.0
body:
## What changes for users

> **Verdict rules changed** (RULES 9 → 10): after the update every PR's verdict is computed
> again, so the first page loads are slower, and blocker counts may change.

_None of the PRs below says what changes for users._



<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v1.22.0 -->

## What's Changed
### Changes
* Roll out safely, install honestly, show the config in effect by @anton-vinogradov in https://github.com/anton-vinogradov/ignite-pr-checker/pull/249
* Fetch only what changed from TeamCity; recompute off the warm cycle by @anton-vinogradov in https://github.com/anton-vinogradov/ignite-pr-checker/pull/250
* Show what each verdict rests on by @anton-vinogradov in https://github.com/anton-vinogradov/ignite-pr-checker/pull/251
* Make failure labels, AI prompts and root causes point the right way by @anton-vinogradov in https://github.com/anton-vinogradov/ignite-pr-checker/pull/252
* Settle every run once and on time, end every story, name the app account by @anton-vinogradov in https://github.com/anton-vinogradov/ignite-pr-checker/pull/253
* Readable verdicts and a signal when they are ready by @anton-vinogradov in https://github.com/anton-vinogradov/ignite-pr-checker/pull/254
### Dependency updates
* Bump actions/setup-java from 4 to 6 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/anton-vinogradov/ignite-pr-checker/pull/237
* Bump actions/checkout from 4 to 7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/anton-vinogradov/ignite-pr-checker/pull/238
* Bump gradle-wrapper from 9.5.0 to 9.8.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/anton-vinogradov/ignite-pr-checker/pull/239

## New Contributors
* @dependabot[bot] made their first contribution in https://github.com/anton-vinogradov/ignite-pr-checker/pull/237
